AIIMS Bhubaneswar Research Officer Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Research Officer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Research Officer. This is a contractual position offered by AIIMS Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Officer position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for this position?
faq.answer: This is a walk-in interview, so there is no specific last date for online application. Candidates need to attend the interview on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Research Officer position is scheduled to be held on 19th August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Public Health, Psychology, Social Work, Sociology, Anthropology, Rural Development, or related fields, along with two years of research experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Research Officer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Officer post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 87,100.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bhubaneswar, Odisha, Pin code 751019.
